note: Quarter turn joining -X <-> +Z, the same canonical orientation as HighwayCorner and the tile bends. monorail-kit is generated by tools/assets/monorail_kit.py and authored in STUDS, so scale is 1.0 and every pos is studs. Origin = bottom centre of the cell at ground level. The beam centreline is a 3.5-radius arc about the cell's (-3.5, +3.5) corner, so it leaves the -X edge at z 0 and the +Z edge at x 0, on a straight's centreline; same profile as MonorailTrack (wheel plane 7.07, soffit 6.10). The pier stands under the arc midpoint (-1.025, +1.025) at rotY -45 so its saddle lies across the beam.
